bell_short_path.scope: Offline independent bell-informed path; inherited train path unchanged; not implemented in device runtime.

limitations: Two positive recording families; insufficient to establish generalization.

audio_policy: No audio, raw microphone recordings or training caches included. The full historic training set is required to refit; bundled frozen parameters support export and application development.
